name: manual_c13468
claim: Preserve revocation-feed unavailability through every approval check, including prepared transaction callbacks, as a retryable nonterminal refusal. Fail closed without poisoning the attempt permanently, and log exception class only rather than secret-bearing messages or tracebacks.

decisions.notes: Oramasys #91 review required both retained and prepared approval checks to preserve transient RevocationUnavailable; #92 tests demonstrate outage recovery, one send and receipt replay. https://github.com/oramasys/oramasys/pull/91#pullrequestreview-5752803940 ; https://github.com/oramasys/oramasys/blob/f89f82c6c8e256378fac0f9b072738f0f28480f1/docs/release12-postmerge-qualification-2026-11-04.md
